attributes.title: Separate committed source access from knowledge construction

alignment.basis: Supports compounding product knowledge and coherent reciprocal engineering development under ADR 0038.

ambition.basis: Refactors an actual shared low-level responsibility; no new product operation.

horizon.basis: Six existing functions and four real direct import sites support a bounded reversible extraction.

realization.basis: Canonical route inquiry 46099682031 identified four direct avoidable edges; extracted module is a proposed intervention.

disposition_history.authority: agent construction selection within delegated self-development
disposition_history.rationale: Separate the source boundary while retaining behavior, compatibility and existing authority; reject broad Git or materialization redesign.

attributes.synthesis_basis: Extract the six existing source-access and evidence-path functions verbatim into a shared low-level module, preserve old import names as aliases, and migrate the four real source-only consumers. Keep current checkout semantics, snapshot construction and review authority distinct.
attributes.value_hypothesis: A software-development agent can extend source-only operations independently of the semantic snapshot builder by sharing a dedicated exact-source access boundary, without changing existing source-materialization or knowledge-query behavior.
attributes.revisit_when: A later actual consumer encounters a consequential compatibility or boundary problem, or file:src/sensemaking_skills/semantic_architecture/source_access.py changes.
attributes.counterevidence: The old shared module worked and aliases retain some imports by design. A module move does not prove global runtime independence, improved performance, easier future changes, or independent cognitive benefit; check actual source/knowledge operation outputs and remaining route candidates.
attributes.claim_ceiling: Source-grounded prospective responsibility; no observed outcome yet.

value_frame.beneficiary: A software-development agent extending source-only operations or semantic knowledge construction without unnecessary dependencies.
value_frame.criterion: Four existing source-only consumers no longer import or have a witnessed bounded candidate route to the snapshot-builder module, while each reaches the same extracted source-access boundary directly, original functions remain compatible, and actual existing source/knowledge operations on identical BASE source produce the same scoped results.
value_frame.comparison_baseline: Current mixed module and original four direct import edges.
value_frame.expected_observation: Six source-access functions move without body changes; all four consumers directly import source_access; bounded post-change source-route inquiries return FOUND to source_access and NO_ROUTE_FOUND_WITHIN_BOUNDS to knowledge_sources, no reverse route from source_access to builder. Existing real source-route, refactor-rename and context-for/knowledge projection operations on the same original source return equivalent payloads, except explicitly identified checkout/cache metadata. Canonical co-design rehearses the actual eight-path source/knowledge increment with separate candidate preflight.
value_frame.would_change_decision_if: Behavior changes, any selected consumer still reaches builder through examined static candidates, old import compatibility is lost, or new ownership creates inconsistent authority.
value_frame.cost_and_downside: One small module, four redirected import sites, compatibility aliases. No new command, schema or materialization contract.
